scope: Public native compact-block adapter source, not endpoint deployment, cold recovery or production capacity qualification.

review.nativeApiCompatibility: Pinned NodeBlockProvider includeTransactions path returns block.body directly as Body; getBlock receives typed BlockHash selector and disables optional publication/attestation expansion. Existing official extraMiddlewares run before bodyParser.
review.boundedInput: Exact route/method/content type, no Origin, fixed four-field selector, configured tier only, positive u32 number/canonical field hash, declared and streamed 1024-byte cap; fixed errors.
review.boundedEncoding: All effect category arrays, per-effect and aggregate field counts preflight before body flattening/stringification. Private padded field bounds and zero trailing padding checked. Repeated preflight after header await prevents relying on earlier count. Fixed 24575 field capacity bounds 2MiB JSON construction; native archiver resident allocation remains outside this bound.
review.canonicality: Network/proof/readiness and configured-tier height plus typed metadata/header hash checked before/after encoding. Header reconstructed to avoid trusting cached hash. Mandatory d9 client independently authenticates full effects root; server does not duplicate it.
review.ownership: Captured native methods preserve original node receiver, immutable primitive config. One shared active handler, no queue/retry/fallback/lifecycle calls. Abort suppresses response/next calls but retains ownership until original await settles.
review.middleware: Exact-route Koa bridge disables Koa response and awaits raw handler; other routes delegate. Native SDK request body is read before standard parser only when installed via official middleware hook.

workerHistoricalSuite.cleanup: Every owned HTTP listener closed in finally; BarretenbergSync singleton destroyed in after hook; child exited normally.

workerFinalAffectedTier.cleanup: Listener and BB singleton closed; process exited normally.

checks.reason: Parent serialized native/heavy slot occupied by genuine notification campaign; no native imports or services invoked.
checks.priorD9IndependentTests: 40 SDK tests already independently passed and recorded in compact-d9e-final-review.json.

requiredBeforeUse: Run independent final ef368 SDK/HTTP suite in granted short slot; recorded worker 35 full tests plus corrected-tier case are supporting evidence, not an independent final rerun.
Review actual CLI registration using one adapter per shared server and actual services.aztec[0]; confirm middleware route ownership before body parser with actual official server integration.

Caller/client must enforce streamed response cap before JSON parsing and authenticate full response with reviewed d9 verifier against independently canonical network/tier/header context; adapter response alone is not authenticated private discovery.

Owning HTTP server must retain bounded request-body/connection and lifecycle cleanup policy; adapter deliberately has no timeout and holds singleflight while native request is unsettled. No detached timeout may release it early.
Browser Origin requests are intentionally denied; any future gateway/client route must preserve explicit public-only boundary instead of silently relaxing this check.
Measure actual maximum-category/aggregate CPU and RSS and native archiver allocation before claiming bounded end-to-end cold recovery; current limits cover input and compact encoding only.
noQualificationClaims: No registered endpoint/deployed Linux or real-chain compact request
No private note/event authentication or incremental discovery by this module
